title: تحسين بطاقة التغييرات — اجتازت الفحوصات
summary: عرض مختصر في الرئيسية، وتفاصيل كاملة عند الضغط، مع محاذاة صحيحة للنصوص العربية والإنجليزية. سجل التغييرات السابق محفوظ بالكامل.

changes.detail: The latest report starts collapsed instead of consuming the dashboard with technical details.
Home titles and summaries use at most two lines when collapsed; expansion restores the complete text and details.
Arabic and Latin report text use their own reading direction instead of forcing English text into the Arabic interface direction.
Smaller Home title and more readable timestamp text improve the mobile card hierarchy. All historical reports remain unchanged.
Removed a duplicated trailing fragment from generated Expo route declarations after verifying that the retained declaration parses correctly.

validation.detail: 6/6 passed, including collapsed Home, expansion, Arabic labels, English text direction, archive preservation and retry. Initial Arabic test incorrectly reused an already-expanded component; corrected the test to mount a fresh Home.
